proposed_abilities.description: Create or verify an agent-root-signed declaration over one exact strictly verified public-surface binding without claiming live registry match or hosted acceptance.
Create or verify a separately signed withdrawal over one exact adoption without mutating or erasing the adopted record.

notes: This descriptor is a declaration-only local hint, not an installed KINGDOM host contract or active Nen ability.

A valid signature proves only that the holder of the embedded root key signed the exact canonical adoption or withdrawal; it does not prove live registry match, hosted acceptance, action authorization, or training clearance.
wake_projection is a signed request only: public_pointer requires requested_visibility public, every record keeps wake_effect false, and this package never projects or publishes a WAKE pointer.
Withdrawal reasons are closed to not_disclosed, identity_choice, binding_compromised, and surface_retired; superseded is intentionally absent and replacement requires a separate adoption.
The records have no API, database, WAKE, Chronicle, memory, observation-counter, KARMA, score, training, public-index, publication, or deployment effect.
